lines.text: Barnaby the giant elephant was the strongest, mightiest animal in the jungle!
Tiny Andy the ant waved his antennae and chirped, Want to be best friends, giant?
Barnaby laughed heartily, You are too microscopic to ever help a big elephant like me!
The next afternoon, Barnaby's heavy leg stepped into a thick tangle of vines!
He pulled and trumpeted in panic, but the sturdy knots grew tighter and tighter!
Andy rallied his army of one hundred tiny ants with sharp, helpful jaws!
Snip, snap, crunch! The tiny ants chewed right through the heavy tangled vines!
Barnaby stepped free, bowed low, and learned that nobody is ever too small to help!
